divisions.headline: Jonesing takes control of the A race, answering a 14-dart 501 by Element with a 17-darter to tie it, then ripping the 1001 in just 40 darts (side note: Element has lost twice in the last 91 RDL weeks, with both being 1001s to Jonesing); Wing leap-frogs Darty with a 501 sweep to grab 4th; Appetite coasts to 4-1

picks.text: The Inflationary Element @ Appetite for Destruction. With Jonesing knocking off both of these teams in the last two weeks, this is suddenly the battle for 2nd. I'll stick with my Element, 14-10.
Wing & A Plaque @ Son of a Beach. The battle for a spot in the league's top four is a carousel of results each week. Does that mean it's Beach's turn then? Of course it does, duh. 13-11.
Jonesing for Mugs 18, Dart Attack 6

divisions.headline: Serious gets a critical 501 sweep over Possee to stay unbeaten; Kids just slowly east past Inconsistent, and into the B marquee match tonight; Angry Birds drop ASP bomb on Only

picks.text: The Kids who say "Ni!" @ Why So Serious? If it hadn't taken the Kids a week to get on track this season, this would be another battle of unbeatens. It's still a head-to-head for the lead in B though, so the drama here is off the charts. You know, I didn't think I would pick against Serious again this fall, but here I am… Kids, 13-11.
picks.call: You know, I didn't think I would pick against Serious again this fall, but here I am… Kids, 13-11.

picks.text: Liquor Possee @ Consistently Inconsistent. The Possee is two matches out of first, but because of their strong point total, they mostly control their own fate. They get this, 14-10.
Angry Birds 14, Bottoms Up 10

divisions.headline: Menace, after trailing 8-4, gets back on track with a full doubles sweep of the Secrets; Mafia, Area and Projectile all race to big singles leads, and then all just keep on racing out

picks.text: Menace 2 Sobriety @ Area 501. What the heck was that week 5 hibernation act Menace pulled? That's the only thing preventing this from being yet another battle of unbeatens. Alas, this is just another rung on Area's climb to B (and A?). Area it is, 14-10.
picks.call: Alas, this is just another rung on Area's climb to B (and A?). Area it is, 14-10.

picks.text: Mulligans Mafia 15, Pints and Points 9

divisions.headline: Rally sweeps two sets on the way to another big win; Knights build a big singles lead and coast to keeping 2nd place; Sanchez tops shorthanded Bullies, opens a two-match gap between 3rd and 4th; Niners sweep doubles from Stumble

picks.text: Darty Sanchez @ Point & Rally. After an 0-2 start, Sanchez is now 4-2 and alone in 3rd. They'll still be 3rd after this one, but they will another match behind the leaders. Point Rallies here, 15-9.

One Armed Bandits @ Nine Lives; The Bullies @ Shooter McGavin. The bottom five in D are so close together that's it's about one or two darts from 4th to friggin' last. Thus, battles within that quintet are just extra super-important. Still love the Niners more than I should, 15-9; and… McGavin? 13-11?

divisions.headline: Death Throws trails big against Cheapies, but then rips off huge doubles; Two Time sweeps two sets, now lurks right behind the leaders; Down to F shoots the Sharks a bunch

picks.text: Two Time @ Down to F, Again. Don't look now, but if Two Time gets help from Nein Mark, they could find them- selves leading F by the end of the night. They win, but only 13-11.
Shark Shooters @ That's What She Said. Ok, look… it's only 3 matches and 13 points from first to last in F. ALL F teams are still in this title chase. Yep, all. She Said to win, 14-10.
Death Throw 13, Nein Mark 11

divisions.headline: Undefeated Rippin rolls into wk06, and… forfeits?!; Banging just ekes past the winless team, now finds themselves in a title matchup; Flight Club takes out Aim-ing in fight for 3rd

picks.text: Banging the Wire @ Rippin Darts. The stunning forfeit loss by Rippin last week all of a sudden turned a runaway race into a full-on battle for first! Since nobody has outdueled them on an actual dartboard yet, I still have to ride the Rippin train here, 15-9.
picks.call: Since nobody has outdueled them on an actual dartboard yet, I still have to ride the Rippin train here, 15-9.
